reviews.text: I use their services about twice a year. However, looking at reviews here, there seems to be a mix of positive and negative opinions. They always trim my pet's nails, and they'll even trim tangled fur if I ask. However, I don't think it's suitable for dogs or cats with serious illnesses. Personally, I wish they would clearly state the items included in the health check and the fees.

Even without an appointment, patients are seen in the order they arrive. The doctor is efficient, so most people don't have to wait long, and there aren't that many people waiting. However, it's quite crowded at this time of year because of the high volume of vaccinations.

I was troubled by my toy poodle's tear staining and was unsure whether to undergo the surgery recommended by an eye specialist, so I consulted with my family doctor, Dr. Imoto. He explained things to me very carefully, and I felt relieved. He doesn't charge a consultation fee, and he is a genuine veterinarian who puts animals first.
He also has a wonderful personality, like Dr. Akahige.
I'm so glad I found such a wonderful hospital! ^_^

I adopted a rescued cat and now live with it. I originally started going to Imoto Animal Hospital after being recommended by someone at a cat shelter. The doctor is very trustworthy and is considerate of not only the cats but also the owners' feelings. I think there are many animal hospitals that do not allow you to be present during examinations, but Dr. Imoto is always happy to be present, which is another plus. He always performs procedures efficiently, so just watching him puts me at ease. The hospital is in Ginza, and it is very conscientious, which is very helpful as a pet owner.
Finally, the wife at the reception desk is very friendly, and the staff are wonderful as well.

They provide excellent and thorough treatment at very reasonable prices. It's a highly trustworthy animal hospital.

Sometimes, if you choose the wrong animal hospital, you can be charged exorbitant amounts. Just because a building is nice and has a well-maintained website doesn't necessarily mean it's safe. This hospital embodies the idea that older, more established hospitals often provide more attentive and caring service.

I've moved away from Ginza and probably won't have the opportunity to visit again, but I highly recommend this hospital to anyone living near Ginza.

My dog ​​ate something it shouldn't have while we were traveling, so we took it to the vet.

I was filled with anxiety, but the doctor and nurses were so kind and reassuring.

Thank you so much.

Thank you for taking care of my dog's neutering!

I'm so glad the wound healed nicely.

I'll definitely use your services again if needed.

This veterinarian is very responsive and quick!
The dog that greets you is adorable too! 😆 …
This is a trustworthy veterinary hospital that administers medication and examines animals right in front of you. I would like them to become your regular doctor.

I was nervous because it was my first time, but the doctor, nurses, and even the price were all amazing. I'm so grateful.
I would definitely recommend this to my family and clients!
I've found my favorite animal hospital! ^_^
This is a very trustworthy clinic.

Over 20 years ago, I found a kitten with an injured leg on my way to work. When I took it in, they treated it with genuine care and kindness, treating it like a stray kitten. They reassured me, a complete novice at the time, that I could approach the cat without any psychological burden. This put me at ease, and I ended up living with the kitten. Eventually, the kitten had kittens, and I enjoyed three generations of happiness with my feline family for twenty years. Dr. Imoto's words were the catalyst. Although I haven't seen him in almost twenty years, I still remember him vividly. I can't express my gratitude enough.
